text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":50000,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"pension of $50,000/year"},{"id":"q2","value":20,"unit":"years","kind":"count","span":"after 20 years"},{"id":"q3","value":5,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"5% of the"},{"id":"q4","value":30,"unit":"years","kind":"count","span":"quits after 30"}],"plan":[{"op":"sub","args":["q4","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"years she was entitled to the bonus, years beyond 20"},{"op":"div","args":["q3"],"out":"s2","note":"convert 5% to a fraction by dividing by 100"},{"op":"mul","args":["s2","q1"],"out":"s3","note":"5% of her annual pension value"},{"op":"mul","args":["s3","s1"],"out":"s4","note":"total additional pension = 5% of pension times qualifying years"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"her annual pension amount after quitting at 30 years"},"dismissed":[{"value":40,"reason":"years needed for the full pension; not used since she quits early at 30 years"}]}
